text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's not first place, but I didn't do so
bad.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hopefully I can be a little less cringe
next time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, cut it out. I hate compliments like
that...
choice_data_list: You looked plenty cool out there!
You looked plenty cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Agh! Enough! I don't need your
commentary.
You're smothering me!
choice_data_list: I'm not flattering you! The way you ran that race was—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Basically, you're saying I did good for me. Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Not like I care what you think anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Coming in first is the coolest. I'm not
gonna leave
things like this.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You can say it depends on me all you
want, but
that doesn't mean I know how
to win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, all confident. Are you
being serious
right now?
choice_data_list: That's what a Trainer is here for.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: I'll do everything in my power to secure a win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Well, you said it. Help me win, then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'll even quit being all flaky. That's the
part that
depends on me, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wipe that smug look off your face!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whatevs. I won't lose again, so give it
everything
you've got.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
When I say I'm gonna do something, I do
it.
